title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的诞生

texts.zh:
自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该使这种贸易市场合法化，让大家都可从中受益。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
texts.en:
De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is time to legitimize this commercial forum so that all may benefit.

In the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. We would surely benefit were this hub to fall within [Root.GetAdj] space, so we can choose to promote one of our worlds for this purpose.

texts.zh:
遗憾的是，我们一直未能有效地打击与异种社会的违法贸易。同样令人遗憾的是，这一不受外交关系影响而且几乎匿名的贸易市场带来了实实在在的利润。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如能主导此贸易中心的运营，想必一定会比囤积外星货物要有用得多，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
texts.en:
It is a regrettable fact that we have consistently failed to quash the illicit trade with the xenos. Equally regrettable is that the economic benefits of a largely anonymous forum for trade decoupled from international relations cannot be denied.

In the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. The economic gains from playing host to such a nexus might well outweigh the burden of harboring alien goods, so we can choose to promote one of our worlds for this purpose.

texts.zh:
星际消费者们，客户们还有各位乡巴佬们，终于准备好迎接一个准中心化的平台进行轻监管的、中等规模的国际贸易。

我们可以提名一个我们的星球成为贸易枢纽，通过这种方式以获得最大化的潜在收入。
texts.en:
The customers, clients, and rubes of the galaxy at long last seem ready to accept a quasi-centralized platform for deregulated, mid-scale international commerce.

We can promote one of our worlds to play host to this commercial hub, to maximize potential revenue.

summary.text:
# 银河市场的诞生 / Birth of the Galactic Market

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/on_action_events_2.txt, common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt, common/event_chains/00_event_chains_3.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

决议 resolution_galactic_market_form 通过（common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt:13216）后对提议国触发 action.96（events/on_action_events_2.txt:13-69）。
Passing the founding resolution fires action.96 on the proposer.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. action.96 “银河市场的诞生”：开启全局提名期（ongoing_market_nomination）和事件链“创建银河市场”；向其余成员触发 action.97 “银河市场的诞生”；选项按是否商业联合体（a “让贸易流动！”/ b “明白了”）。解锁决定“提名银河市场主办地”。
   action.96 opens the nomination period and the chain "Founding the Galactic Market", informs the others with action.97, and unlocks the nomination decision.
2. 提名期结束（@galactic_market_nomination_period）后全局隐藏 action.98：有被提名的合格星球 → 选出主办星球 → action.99 → action.104 “银河市场：设立于…”→ action.101 通知所有成员；无合格提名 → 提议国 action.1000、其他成员 action.1005 “银河市场未能建立”。（这几页属于故事“银河共同体·重新安置/建立市场”）
   After the period, hidden action.98 either picks the host (-> 99 -> 104 -> 101) or announces failure (1000 / 1005); those pages belong to the Galactic Community market story.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 提名结果互斥：设立 / 无人提名失败。 Founding and failure are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 正文按是否排外、是否商业联合体而变。 Text varies with xenophobia and megacorp status.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：action.96-99、104、1000、1005、101 的触发与分派；市场搬迁 action.102/103 与接入 action.105/115 见相邻故事。
- 说明 Note：设立/失败的页面由故事 event-galcom-62（另一审阅者）持有，这里只保留提议阶段。 The establishment/failure pages belong to event-galcom-62.
